setwd("D:/student_club")
getwd()
clubs  <- read.csv("club_engagements_new.csv")
events <- read.csv("event_roi_new.csv")
head(clubs)
head(events)

```{r club-engagement}
clubs$Attendance_Rate   <- round(clubs$Avg_Attendance / clubs$Members * 100, 1)
clubs$Consistency_Rate  <- round(clubs$Regular_Participants / clubs$Members * 100, 1)
clubs$Interaction_Score <- clubs$Competition_Entries + clubs$Workshops_Attended

clubs$Engagement_Score <- round(
  0.30 * clubs$Attendance_Rate +
  0.30 * clubs$Consistency_Rate +
  0.20 * (clubs$Interaction_Score / max(clubs$Interaction_Score) * 100) +
  0.20 * (clubs$Feedback_Rating / 5 * 100), 1)

ranked <- clubs[order(-clubs$Engagement_Score),
                c("Club_Name","Members","Attendance_Rate","Consistency_Rate","Engagement_Score")]

print(ranked, row.names = FALSE)
```

hour_value   <- 50
member_value <- 200

done <- subset(events, Status == "Completed")

done$Total_Cost    <- done$Money_Spent_INR + done$Volunteer_Hours * hour_value
done$Total_Benefit <- done$Sponsorship_INR + done$Ticket_Revenue_INR +
                      done$New_Memberships * member_value
done$ROI_Percent   <- round((done$Total_Benefit - done$Total_Cost) /
                             done$Total_Cost * 100, 1)
done$Crowd_vs_Expected <- round(done$Actual_Attendance /
                                done$Expected_Attendance * 100, 0)




roi_table <- done[, c("Event_Name","Total_Cost","Total_Benefit","ROI_Percent","Crowd_vs_Expected")]
print(roi_table, row.names = FALSE)

barplot(ranked$Engagement_Score, names.arg = ranked$Club_Name,
        las = 2, col = "steelblue", main = "Club Engagement Score",
        ylab = "Score (out of 100)")

barplot(roi_table$ROI_Percent, names.arg = roi_table$Event_Name,
        col = c("darkorange", "seagreen"), main = "Event ROI (%)",
        ylab = "ROI %")


#financial-metrices
hour_value   <- 50
member_value <- 200

done <- subset(events, Status == "Completed")

done$Total_Cost    <- done$Money_Spent_INR + done$Volunteer_Hours * hour_value
done$Total_Revenue <- done$Sponsorship_INR + done$Ticket_Revenue_INR
done$Total_Benefit <- done$Total_Revenue + done$New_Memberships * member_value

done$Financial_ROI          <- round((done$Total_Benefit - done$Total_Cost) / done$Total_Cost * 100, 1)
done$Cost_per_Attendee      <- round(done$Total_Cost / done$Actual_Attendance, 1)
done$Revenue_per_Attendee   <- round(done$Total_Revenue / done$Actual_Attendance, 1)
done$Budget_Utilization     <- round(done$Money_Spent_INR / done$Planned_Budget_INR * 100, 1)
done$Sponsorship_Share      <- round(done$Sponsorship_INR / done$Total_Cost * 100, 1)
done$Break_Even_Attendance  <- ceiling((done$Total_Cost - done$Sponsorship_INR) / done$Ticket_Price_INR)

fin_table <- done[, c("Event_Name","Financial_ROI","Cost_per_Attendee","Revenue_per_Attendee",
                      "Budget_Utilization","Sponsorship_Share","Break_Even_Attendance","Paid_Attendees")]
print(fin_table, row.names = FALSE)


#financial graph
par(mfrow = c(2, 3), mar = c(5, 4, 3, 1))

# 1. Financial ROI (%)
barplot(done$Financial_ROI, names.arg = done$Event_Name,
        col = c("darkorange", "seagreen"), main = "Financial ROI (%)",
        ylab = "ROI %", ylim = c(0, max(done$Financial_ROI) * 1.2))

# 2. Cost vs revenue per attendee
barplot(rbind(done$Cost_per_Attendee, done$Revenue_per_Attendee),
        beside = TRUE, names.arg = done$Event_Name,
        col = c("tomato", "seagreen"), main = "Cost vs Revenue per Attendee",
        ylab = "INR per attendee",
        legend.text = c("Cost", "Revenue"), args.legend = list(x = "topleft"))

# 3. Budget utilization (%)
barplot(done$Budget_Utilization, names.arg = done$Event_Name,
        col = "steelblue", main = "Budget Utilization (%)",
        ylab = "% of planned budget", ylim = c(0, 110))
abline(h = 100, lty = 2, col = "red")   # red line = full budget

# 4. Sponsorship contribution (%)
barplot(done$Sponsorship_Share, names.arg = done$Event_Name,
        col = "purple", main = "Sponsorship Contribution (%)",
        ylab = "% of total cost", ylim = c(0, 100))

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))




#Student engagement matrix
# Event-level
done$Reg_to_Attendance <- round(done$Actual_Attendance / done$Registered_Students * 100, 1)
done$Repeat_Rate       <- round(done$Returning_Participants / done$Previous_Participants * 100, 1)

# Club-level
clubs$Active_Member_Rate  <- round(clubs$Regular_Participants / clubs$Members * 100, 1)
clubs$Membership_Growth   <- round((clubs$Members - clubs$Previous_Members) / clubs$Previous_Members * 100, 1)
clubs$Retention_Rate      <- round(clubs$Retained_Members / clubs$Previous_Members * 100, 1)
clubs$Cross_Club_Rate     <- round(clubs$Multi_Club_Members / clubs$Members * 100, 1)

event_eng <- done[, c("Event_Name","Reg_to_Attendance","Repeat_Rate")]
club_eng  <- clubs[order(-clubs$Retention_Rate),
                   c("Club_Name","Active_Member_Rate","Membership_Growth","Retention_Rate","Cross_Club_Rate")]
print(event_eng, row.names = FALSE)
print(club_eng,  row.names = FALSE)


#graph
par(mfrow = c(2, 3), mar = c(8, 4, 3, 1))

# 1. Event: registration-to-attendance vs repeat participation
barplot(rbind(done$Reg_to_Attendance, done$Repeat_Rate),
        beside = TRUE, names.arg = done$Event_Name,
        col = c("steelblue", "orange"), main = "Event Engagement Rates (%)",
        ylab = "%", ylim = c(0, 110),
        legend.text = c("Registration to attendance", "Repeat participation"),
        args.legend = list(x = "topright", cex = 0.7))

# 2. Club: active member rate
ord <- clubs[order(-clubs$Active_Member_Rate), ]
barplot(ord$Active_Member_Rate, names.arg = ord$Club_Name, las = 2,
        col = "steelblue", main = "Active Member Rate (%)", ylab = "%")

# 3. Club: membership growth
ord <- clubs[order(-clubs$Membership_Growth), ]
barplot(ord$Membership_Growth, names.arg = ord$Club_Name, las = 2,
        col = "seagreen", main = "Membership Growth (%)", ylab = "%")

# 4. Club: retention rate
ord <- clubs[order(-clubs$Retention_Rate), ]
barplot(ord$Retention_Rate, names.arg = ord$Club_Name, las = 2,
        col = "darkorange", main = "Student Retention Rate (%)", ylab = "%")

# 5. Club: cross-club participation
ord <- clubs[order(-clubs$Cross_Club_Rate), ]
barplot(ord$Cross_Club_Rate, names.arg = ord$Club_Name, las = 2,
        col = "purple", main = "Cross-Club Participation (%)", ylab = "%")

# 6. Club: overall engagement score (from the earlier chunk)
barplot(ranked$Engagement_Score, names.arg = ranked$Club_Name, las = 2,
        col = "tomato", main = "Club Engagement Score", ylab = "Score (out of 100)")

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))





#quality matrix and event performance score
# Normalise all five components to 0-100
A <- done$Reg_to_Attendance
S <- done$Satisfaction_Rating / 5 * 100
L <- done$Learning_Outcome_Score / 5 * 100
R <- done$Repeat_Rate
C <- pmin(100, done$Total_Revenue / done$Total_Cost * 100)

done$EPS <- round(0.30*A + 0.25*S + 0.20*L + 0.15*R + 0.10*C, 1)

# Popularity index and networking
social_pa <- done$Social_Media_Engagements / done$Actual_Attendance
social_idx <- social_pa / max(social_pa) * 100
done$Popularity_Index <- round((pmin(100, done$Actual_Attendance / done$Expected_Attendance * 100) + social_idx) / 2, 1)
done$Networking_per_Attendee <- round(done$Networking_Connections / done$Actual_Attendance, 2)

quality_table <- done[, c("Event_Name","Satisfaction_Rating","Learning_Outcome_Score",
                          "Networking_per_Attendee","Popularity_Index","EPS")]
print(quality_table, row.names = FALSE)

#graph
par(mfrow = c(2, 3), mar = c(5, 4, 3, 1))

# 1. Satisfaction vs learning outcome (out of 5)
barplot(rbind(done$Satisfaction_Rating, done$Learning_Outcome_Score),
        beside = TRUE, names.arg = done$Event_Name,
        col = c("steelblue", "orange"), main = "Satisfaction vs Learning (out of 5)",
        ylim = c(0, 5.5),
        legend.text = c("Satisfaction", "Learning"),
        args.legend = list(x = "topright", cex = 0.8))

# 2. Networking per attendee
barplot(done$Networking_per_Attendee, names.arg = done$Event_Name,
        col = "purple", main = "Networking Connections per Attendee",
        ylab = "Connections")

# 3. Popularity index
barplot(done$Popularity_Index, names.arg = done$Event_Name,
        col = "seagreen", main = "Event Popularity Index",
        ylab = "Score (0-100)", ylim = c(0, 110))

# 4. Event Performance Score
barplot(done$EPS, names.arg = done$Event_Name,
        col = c("darkorange", "seagreen"), main = "Event Performance Score (EPS)",
        ylab = "Score (0-100)", ylim = c(0, 100))

# 5. What makes up each EPS (stacked)
contrib <- rbind(Attendance = 0.30 * A, Satisfaction = 0.25 * S,
                 Learning = 0.20 * L, Repeat = 0.15 * R, Cost_Eff = 0.10 * C)
barplot(contrib, names.arg = done$Event_Name,
        col = c("steelblue", "orange", "seagreen", "purple", "tomato"),
        main = "EPS Breakdown by Component", ylab = "EPS points",
        legend.text = rownames(contrib), args.legend = list(x = "bottomright", cex = 0.7))

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
